Payout of 7 July is short ₹5,714.74.
The bank credited ₹2,64,981.07 against an expected ₹2,70,695.81. 17 orders sit in this payout. 2 different combinations of ledger entries add up to this difference and nothing in the records tells them apart, so no single explanation can be given.
Suggested action: ask the gateway which entries it deducted from this payout, since the amounts alone cannot separate them.
